text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions Citation and and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1989 and shall be deemed to have Commencecome into force on 1st November, 1989. ment.

In this Order unless the context otherwise requires -Interpretation. "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority; "Minister" means the person appointed under subsections (4) or

(9) of section 4 of the Constitution who is for the time being charged with the responsibility for the subject matter to which the written law specified in the Schedule refers.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of the functions. law specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
